## Summary

- broaden automatic Humanoid name normalization and aliases across common DCC and game-engine rig conventions
- use required hierarchy relationships to disambiguate candidates and conservatively infer a shared Hips parent for branching rigs such as MMD semi-standard skeletons
- add synthetic SkeletonAsset regression coverage for existing Mixamo-style detection, MMD branching hips, Unreal-style side suffixes, Biped-style prefixes, and unnamed branching hips

## Architecture

ADR 0110 required semantics and structural validation remain unchanged. Authored Humanoid profile reconciliation is unchanged. All new detection tests construct BoneDef/SkeletonAsset data directly in crates/animation and do not depend on third-party model or animation files.
